title: Arena Privacy & Event Data Notice
subtitle: How your anonymous participant data and live gameplay metrics are handled during the Incubation Lab Inauguration Event.

sections.title: 1. Anonymous Participation
content: Participation is completely anonymous. We do not collect or require your email address, phone number, real name, or personal account credentials.
Your device is identified strictly by an ephemeral device token and your assigned Guest ID (e.g. Guest042).

sections.title: 2. Air-Gapped Local Storage
content: All scores and game events are processed entirely on the local Incubation Lab server over venue Wi-Fi.
Zero data is sent to external clouds, third-party analytics, or commercial advertising networks.

sections.title: 3. 12-Hour Automatic Expiration
content: Client tokens and browser cookies are set with a strict 12-hour lifetime.
All local session tokens self-destruct after the inauguration event concludes, leaving your phone completely clean.

sections.title: 4. Leaderboard & Score Visibility
content: During live gameplay, your Guest ID, Orb Number, and running point score are broadcast to the venue display screen.
No personal identity is ever linked to your public scoreboard handle.

sections.title: 5. Event Inquiries
content: For questions regarding the inauguration event, reach out to the Incubation Lab organizing committee at the main event stage.

contactCard.title: Have Questions During the Event?
contactCard.description: Speak directly with our technical coordinators stationed at the Incubation Lab control desk.
